title: Boreas: A multi-season autonomous driving dataset
limitations: LiDAR 128 beam; Objects-V1 sunny only; 37 official training scenes/16 hidden-label test scenes; no difficulty tiers.

title: PointPillars: Fast Encoders for Object Detection from Point Clouds
limitations: Pillar representation. Cite this paper for internal PointPillars Lite; Lite itself is a channel-width ablation.

title: SECOND: Sparsely Embedded Convolutional Detection
limitations: Publisher metadata verified; direct full-text access rate-limited in this search. Measured runtime must come from our hardware.

title: Center-based 3D Object Detection and Tracking
limitations: Original paper includes refinement; describe the actual one-stage OpenPCDet variant used in our experiment.

title: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking
limitations: Distinguish original method from our NMS-enabled implementation configuration.

title: PV-RCNN: Point-Voxel Feature Set Abstraction for 3D Object Detection
limitations: Point-voxel feature abstraction and proposal refinement.

title: PillarNet: Real-Time and High-Performance Pillar-based 3D Object Detection
limitations: Useful precedent for accuracy-speed trade-offs and pillar encoding; sparse 2D operators are still sparse operators.

title: Robo3D: Towards Robust and Reliable 3D Perception against Corruptions
limitations: Eight corruptions; mCE/mRR must not be treated as interchangeable with our AP drops.

title: Benchmarking Robustness of 3D Object Detection to Common Corruptions
limitations: KITTI-C/nuScenes-C/Waymo-C; 27 corruption types and 24 detectors. Title here follows CVF BibTeX; PDF adds in Autonomous Driving.

title: An Empirical Study of the Generalization Ability of Lidar 3D Object Detectors to Unseen Domains
limitations: Nine detectors/six benchmarks; architecture, voxel encoding, augmentation and anchors affect generalization. Full author list follows PDF/arXiv.

title: An Investigation of Beam Density on LiDAR Object Detection Performance
limitations: Dense 128-beam setting; architecture comparison and beam-induced domain gaps. Do not claim beam-density evaluation is new.

title: Impact of LiDAR beam loss on 3D object detection: A systematic analysis of vulnerable road user safety
limitations: Publisher public metadata/abstract only; full text unavailable. Beam loss depends on beam location; avoid inferring unpublished protocol details.

title: Evaluating LiDAR Perception Algorithms for All-Weather Autonomy
limitations: Full text read. Boreas-Objects synthetic fog, CADC snow; pretrained PointPillars, downsample 128 to 32; filtering emphasis. Different class/range/evaluation protocol.

title: Augmentation of LiDAR Scenes with Adverse Weather Conditions Using Latent Diffusion Models
usage: Boreas prior work, optional weather expansion
limitations: Publisher citation year 2026, conference ICONIP2025, first online 2025-11-14. Public abstract/metadata only; linked B-3DOD-B-AWC supplies a separate sunny/snow benchmark.

title: LiDAR Distillation: Bridging the Beam-Induced Domain Gap for 3D Object Detection
limitations: Adaptation/distillation method, not an equivalent benchmark; test-only beam reduction and retraining must be distinguished.

title: Are we ready for Autonomous Driving? The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
limitations: Cite official KITTI web protocol separately for AP40: the 2012 paper predates the 2019 AP40 update.

title: nuScenes: A Multimodal Dataset for Autonomous Driving
limitations: Use for dataset comparison, not as data used in our current experiment. nuScenes metrics differ from IoU AP_R40.

title: Scalability in Perception for Autonomous Driving: Waymo Open Dataset
limitations: Large-scale benchmark precedent; complete authors can be imported from publisher if desired.

title: Canadian adverse driving conditions dataset
limitations: Official devkit supplies article citation. Different sensor/classes/domain from Boreas; no claim currently trained/evaluated CADC.

title: The Boreas Dataset
limitations: Official dataset entry; JavaScript-only page, scientific details verified in paper.

title: Boreas Autonomous Driving Dataset — AWS registry
limitations: Official access and CC BY4.0 license record; not downloaded in this task.

title: pyboreas devkit
limitations: Raw format, official scene splits and loader; record exact used commit/version.

title: OpenPCDet: An Open-source Toolbox for 3D Object Detection from Point Clouds
limitations: Cite development team2020 as software; also record actual checkout commit and our changes.

title: KITTI Object Detection Evaluation
limitations: AP40 updated2019-10-08; class IoU thresholds. Our custom Boreas labels lack KITTI difficulty tiers.

title: PyTorch Benchmark recipe
limitations: Warmup, CUDA synchronization and timing overhead; cite documentation when describing runtime protocol.

title: Boreas 3D Object Detection Benchmark for Adverse Weather Conditions (B-3DOD-B-AWC)
limitations: Separate annotation resource: sunny train labels from model inference, snowy test manual labels; classes car/pedestrian/truck; differs from official Objects-V1.

title: CADC devkit
limitations: Official dataset access, labels and citation; future expansion only.

title: Robo3D devkit
limitations: Corruption protocols and reproducibility reference; not currently implemented in our experiment.
